You only choose the attack poses. Idle and walk are filled automatically from the sheets (they are already measured and stable). Click a view to pick its attack poses; on a view you can also untick “weapon” — the weapon art is a front-view item icon, so the away-facing views (NW, N, NE) start with it off. The green cross in each picture is the hand joint I measured from the art — the weapon is pinned to it on every frame, so it stays in the hand as the attack animates. Dragging still nudges it if you want it a pixel or two off that.
Idle & walk: filled from the sheet by me — nothing to do here. Copy the box and send it back; only your attack picks and weapon settings travel in it.
